items.title: BIBA calls for insurance premium tax freeze following Autumn Budget
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, the British Insurance Brokers’ Association has urged the government to freeze and eventually reduce insurance premium tax, as the Autumn Budget left rates unchanged.

items.title: Budget 26 introduces lifetime founders' relief on capital gains tax alongside business relief changes
items.summary: According to Investment Week, chancellor John Healey has unveiled a 10% lifetime founders' relief on capital gains tax alongside a reduction in the business asset disposal relief threshold.

items.title: Venture capital trust tax relief cut remains in place following Budget
items.summary: According to Investment Week, chancellor John Healey left the reduced 20% VCT income tax relief rate unchanged in his maiden Budget, drawing industry criticism.

items.title: Budget 26: State pensioners shielded from income tax
items.summary: According to Investment Week, chancellor John Healey confirms that pensioners with income up to the full new state pension will be excluded from income tax.

items.title: Government confirms HMRC terminal illness definition changes in Budget
items.summary: According to Professional Pensions, the government has confirmed it will alter HM Revenue and Customs’ terminal illness definition in the Finance Bill 2026-27 to align with DWP rules.

items.title: Heritage insurers warn of post-shoot risks as screen tourism rises
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, ecclesiastical highlights the growing physical and security risks heritage property owners face after hosting film and television productions.
